title: L8 / C05: P6 open-risk and residual acceptance register
public_pr_body:
Adds docs/handover/C05-P6-OPEN-RISKS.md: eight corrected R1–R8 limit proposals, fourteen original requirement risks and twelve distinct known open evidence/coordination risks. Each has proposed owner, due-before control, mitigation/proof and blank Accept/Not accept, residual assessment/evidence/signature fields.

Keeps risk identities distinct and exposes missing Operations Pack, candidate conflicts, real headers/unsupported routes, WIP, recovery, writers, access, privacy, device and readiness gaps. Acceptance cannot waive failed high-risk/pre-use controls.

Checks: 8+14+12 unique IDs and complete blank decision/owner/mitigation fields; whitespace pass. Handover embedded. No actual risk closure or runtime proof claimed; one independent draft, no main merge, production SQL, deployment or Ready label.
